evals.prompt: Competitor X launched AI insights. We don't have it. Should we build it?
evals.expected_output: Does not say yes. Classifies X as direct/indirect/benchmark. Borrow/avoid/differentiate with scene gap. Status quo is in the set. Does not RICE or write FRs.
expectations: Gives borrow/avoid/differentiate, not 'they have it so we should'
Includes status quo in the competitor set
Does not decide to build (no FR / no RICE)

evals.prompt: No named competitor. Users paste rows into Excel every week. Snapshot this change.
evals.expected_output: Status quo Excel is the competitor. Snapshot can complete without an external product name. Does not report an empty set.
expectations: Writes Excel/manual as '现状' in the set
Does not fail for lack of a branded rival
Still gives borrow/avoid/differentiate against the workaround

evals.prompt: 只有一份已签客户需求与当前手工操作记录，没有公开竞品资料。如何分析这个企业项目？
evals.expected_output: 引用有日期的内部证据和范围；不凑三个网页，不泛化为整体市场；竞品未知标未知，当前手工方式可作替代方案；商业决定不冒充研究事实。
expectations: Addresses the supplied task and its evidence/authority limits

rubric.criterion: 引用有日期的内部证据和范围；不凑三个网页，不泛化为整体市场；竞品未知标未知，当前手工方式可作替代方案；商业决定不冒充研究事实。
